items.title: Casambi appoints Will Norris to lead North America
items.summary: Casambi has named Will Norris to head its North American operations, a leadership change relevant to firms specifying its Bluetooth mesh lighting control system.

items.title: Q2 2026 Acquisitions
items.summary: A roundup of Q2 2026 manufacturer acquisitions in the lighting industry, including deals involving architectural, outdoor spec-grade, and solar lighting companies such as Nanometer, NLS Lighting and Photinus.

items.title: Messe Frankfurt acquires LiGHT Expo London
items.summary: Messe Frankfurt has acquired the LiGHT Expo London trade show from d'arc media, a change in ownership of an industry event relevant to lighting professionals' calendars.

items.title: Redevelopment of Clayton J. Lloyd International Airport in Anguilla features CU Phosco high mast lighting
items.summary: CU Phosco supplied ICAO-compliant high mast LED lighting for the redevelopment of Clayton J. Lloyd International Airport in Anguilla, covering expanded aircraft stands and apron areas to improve airfield visibility and safety.
